summary.text: Clint Crowe was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2020 and represents District 118, including Butts County, and chairs the Public Safety and Homeland Security Committee.

paragraphs.text: Before running a real estate business, Crowe spent a decade in law enforcement as a patrol officer, field training officer and detective with a metro Atlanta police department; the family company is Crowe Realty.
Crowe holds a Bachelor of Business Administration and an MBA from Mercer University.
